x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

rem = x
res_a = 0
res_b = 1

for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a = max(x * b // y - 10, 0)

    for j in range(20):
        diff = abs(x * b - (a + j) * y)
        if rem * b > diff * res_b:
            rem = diff
            res_a = a + j
            res_b = b
        elif rem * b == diff * res_b:
            if res_b > b or (res_b == b and res_a > a + j):
                res_a = a + j
                res_b = b

print(f"{res_a}/{res_b}")
</translated_code>
